shield.name: Shield Protection
shield.description: Block 1 incoming Draw 2 or Draw 4 penalty completely!

extra_turn.name: Extra Turn
extra_turn.description: Play again immediately without passing the turn!

swap.name: Card Swap
swap.description: Exchange 1 random card with a selected opponent.

color.name: Color Changer
color.description: Instantly select a new active color on the table.

reverse.name: Reverse Master
reverse.description: Reverse the turn order instantly on your turn!

peek.name: Peek Card
peek.description: Privately reveal 1 random card from an opponent hand.

booster.name: Coin Booster
booster.description: Doubles your match victory reward from ₱200 to ₱400!

reflect.name: Attack Reflect
reflect.description: Reflect incoming +2 or +4 penalty back to the attacker!
